description: Shared deterministic baseline graph for STUDY-203 (decomposed agent systems) and reused by STUDY-204 (storage independence). One branching topology containing a result-dependent (conditional) edge at 'branch' and a self-modification trigger at 'grow'. Generic schema: every node carries {id, type}; every edge carries {source_id, target_id, relation}. Domain extras (node 'op'/'data', edge 'condition') are optional and are ignored by a generic graph loader, so the fixture parses without any STUDY-203-only key.
